The outsider is dressed like a bandit, which raises more questions.<NL>The Five Immortals Sect is always heavily guarded and full of toxic miasma—how did ordinary thieves even get in?
eb66f528-9612-43e3-a62b-168d048ac30e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行不多远，便看见四下皆是厮杀的痕迹，<NL>地上横着几具尸体，其中一具似是外族人装束，其余皆是苗人。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>连忙上前，只见那外族人一身贼匪打扮，不禁心中诧异：<NL>五仙教向来防备森严，又是毒瘴丛生，寻常贼寇怎得擅入？

f1cca7a6-6010-4ebc-9c17-2115e7295a61/Eve.en: Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is puzzling over it,<NL>the sounds of battle grow louder ahead.<NL>Worried about Ran Xindu, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pushes the doubts aside and rushes toward the noise...

f1cca7a6-6010-4ebc-9c17-2115e7295a61/Eve.ru: Точно так же, как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> ломает над этим голову,<NL>звуки битвы впереди становятся громче.<NL>Беспокоился о Ран Синду, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> отбрасывает сомнения в сторону и бросается на шум...

eb40637a-535e-438f-b968-dc3f08c3b0d7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行至途中，发现前方一片打斗之声，<NL>只见一群外族贼匪正围攻一名苗人，欲要将其诛杀……

8ff89de8-dba2-4f83-b536-3697fd86ce09/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> бросает взгляд на Пилюлю — она черная, как смоль.<NL>Он издает легкий, успокаивающий аромат, который очищает разум и помогает в детоксикации.<NL>Должно быть, именно так бандитам удалось миновать ядовитые миазмы вокруг Секты пяти Бессмертных...

They scream in fear, crying loudly.<NL>It takes some calm words and gentle explaining from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> before the child finally starts to calm down...

A bunch of outsiders came and took our land.<NL>My parents stood in front of them and told me to run... So I did. I ran without looking back... But they... They didn't make it..."

8643390f-83fb-4f46-9a2e-d2a2ed9e402e/Eve.en: Seeing the child breaking down in tears, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gives them some comfort,<NL>brings them to a safe spot,<NL>and then heads off again to find Ran Xindu...
8643390f-83fb-4f46-9a2e-d2a2ed9e402e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见孩童已是泣不成声，<NL>便又劝慰一番，将其带到安全所在，<NL>随后继续向前寻找苒心毒……

4bbf992a-ddd2-4a31-ae90-bcbe0a302348/Eve.ru: В пути, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> замечает старейшину, лежащего на земле.<NL>Его глаза закрыты, но он все еще дышит — еле-еле.<NL>Похоже, он потерял сознание, вероятно, от истощения и старости после того, как попал во весь этот хаос...

The elder says,<NL><NL>"Thank you for saving me... You've got a kind heart. But...<NL>Those outsiders chased us out of everywhere. And now, they won't even leave this last bit of land alone...
07e6c387-3b61-419f-afed-92f4a835d4a9/Eve.cn: 在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的救治之下，老者渐渐苏醒过来，<NL>然而一见到<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，却露出万分惊恐的神情，<NL>在一番解释过后，老者方才明白发生何事，称谢道：<NL><NL>“多谢相救，你确是一片善心，不过……唉……<NL>只恨外族人一路驱逐我们，如今连这片最后的净土也不放过……”

e74a50e4-d48c-4dbd-b677-538f86c10ab4/Eve.ru: Позже, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> натыкается на маленького мальчика, лежащего без сознания на обочине дороги.<NL>Он тяжело ранен, истекает кровью из многочисленных ран.<NL>На его лице отражается паника, когда он пытается встать, но боль удерживает его на месте...

5e8d5a9c-652d-496b-9e22-528719b801e2/Eve.cn: 在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的医治之下，终于勉强了止住伤势，<NL>然而那少年却是片刻也坐不得，便要起身离去，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>问起发生何事，只见少年咬牙切齿地说道：<NL><NL>“天杀的外族人掳走了我的阿妹，<NL>我便豁出这条性命，也要把阿妹寻回来！”

Fighting side by side, they finally manage to defeat <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>.<NL>In the chaos, <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/> drops a few pills on the ground...
6b80538a-a895-44ff-ac7a-6ed8054119e2/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眼见便要落败，<NL>苒心毒当即上前相助，二人携手作战，终于战胜了<Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>，<NL>只见<Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>慌乱之中将些许药丸遗落于地……
6b80538a-a895-44ff-ac7a-6ed8054119e2/Eve.ru: Как раз тогда, когда <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> вот-вот будет подавлен,<NL>Ран Синду бросается на помощь. Сражаясь бок о бок, им, наконец, удается победить <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>.<NL>В этом хаосе, <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/> роняет несколько Пилюль на землю...

0ad2a14b-086f-4300-8d43-a3f05cb9e462/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has defeated <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>.<NL>In the chaos, <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/> drops a few pills on the ground...
0ad2a14b-086f-4300-8d43-a3f05cb9e462/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>战胜了<Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>，<NL>只见<Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>慌乱之中将些许药丸遗落于地……

11fc1b9c-0db7-40d6-9914-0db589c7c7e9/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> notices the pills are black and give off a faint, pleasant scent...<NL><NL>"This is a unique pill from Miaojiang, used to protect against the toxic miasma.<NL>But these bastards... where did they get it? Did they steal it from my people when they killed them?"<NL>Ran Xindu finishes off the remaining outland raiders and strides over to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>taking the pills from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hand, her eyes burning with anger...
11fc1b9c-0db7-40d6-9914-0db589c7c7e9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>观其色呈乌黑，闻之幽香阵阵……<NL><NL>“这是我苗疆拿来避开毒瘴呢秘药，<NL>这些狗贼又是哪跌来呢，难不成是杀我族人抢来……”<NL>苒心毒将周遭外族贼匪诛杀殆尽，阔步行至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前，<NL>取过<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手中药丸，嗔目切齿道……

11fc1b9c-0db7-40d6-9914-0db589c7c7e9/Opt.en: These raiders have too many of these pills. They can't just be from killing. There must be more to this...
11fc1b9c-0db7-40d6-9914-0db589c7c7e9/Opt.cn: 贼匪身怀此物，数量之多，恐非杀人夺来，此事当另有隐情……
11fc1b9c-0db7-40d6-9914-0db589c7c7e9/Opt.ru: У этих налетчиков слишком много этих таблеток. Они не могут быть просто результатом убийства. За этим должно быть что-то еще...

a1613a70-a5c5-4458-8dfa-79ce3f8a8a64/Eve.en: But what's the hidden truth behind all this?<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can't figure it out just yet. As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> thinks it over,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> suddenly sees Ran Xindu pull something out of her sleeve and toss it into the unconscious <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>'s mouth.<NL><NL>"These damn raiders!<NL>They raid our Miao Stockade, kill our people, steal our unique poisons... Why bother thinking so much about it?<NL>But if <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> really wants to know everything, it's not that hard."
a1613a70-a5c5-4458-8dfa-79ce3f8a8a64/Eve.cn: 只是此间隐情如何，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一时亦难以明了，正自思索之际，<NL>只见苒心毒蓦地自袖中取出一物，将之扔至躺倒在地的<Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>口中：<NL><NL>“狗贼黑心烂肠，<NL>闯我苗寨，杀我族人，夺我秘药，哪跌用想那么多，<NL>不过<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>你偏要知道个清楚明白，又有什么难？”

4c0c164c-a59e-4443-a4cc-8688e4b2cd0a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> senses there's more to this. Something just doesn't add up.<NL>Now that there's a way to uncover the truth, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> doesn't hesitate and nods in agreement.<NL>Ran Xindu continues,<NL><NL>"Place <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>'s hand on his forehead.<NL>Ask whatever you need to know, and you'll see everything <Character key=CombatCharId str=Gender/> has seen.<NL>Once you see for yourself that those bastards killed my people and stole our poisons, I'll make sure <Character key=CombatCharId str=Gender/> suffers a fate worse than death..."
4c0c164c-a59e-4443-a4cc-8688e4b2cd0a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中隐隐只觉此事另有隐情，暗藏玄机，<NL>而今既有法门一探究竟，当即不作推辞，颔首应允，<NL>随后便听身侧苒心毒继续说道：<NL><NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>将手放到<Character key=CombatCharId str=Gender/>呢额头上，<NL>问你想问呢问题，就可以瞧见<Character key=CombatCharId str=Gender/>见过呢事，<NL>等你看清楚了是狗贼杀我族人夺药，我就叫<Character key=CombatCharId str=Gender/>生不能生，死不能死……”

4c0c164c-a59e-4443-a4cc-8688e4b2cd0a/Opt.en: (Do as Ran Xindu says and ask about the unique poisons...)
4c0c164c-a59e-4443-a4cc-8688e4b2cd0a/Opt.cn: （依苒心毒所言行事，询问秘药来由……）
4c0c164c-a59e-4443-a4cc-8688e4b2cd0a/Opt.ru: (Сделайте, как говорит Ран Синду, и спросите об уникальных Ядах...)

c90bef12-44c0-435e-95b7-ddbaca24c26e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> places a hand on the forehead and slowly closes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes,<NL>In that instant, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> feels like floating in empty space, and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind sinks into a sea of thoughts.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> sees a cave, where <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/> stands behind a woman dressed in Miao clothing.<NL>The woman's eyes are red, her forehead glowing, unmistakably a Miaojiang person...<NL><NL>"The Divine Matron of Five Immortals pities your suffering from the toxic miasma,<NL>so she has given you this panacea, allowing you to travel freely throughout the Miaojiang without trouble..."
c90bef12-44c0-435e-95b7-ddbaca24c26e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>以手覆其额，缓缓闭上双目，<NL>霎时周身如浮虚空，神识如坠意海，<NL>但见一处崖洞之中，<Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>正躬身立于一名妇人身后，<NL>那妇人身着苗装，双目发红，额头雪亮，正是一名苗疆蛊妇无疑……<NL><NL>“我教圣姑怜惜尔等受瘴毒所害，<NL>故而赐下神药，令尔等可于苗疆各处往来无碍……”

c90bef12-44c0-435e-95b7-ddbaca24c26e/Opt.en: The Five Immortals Sect has always been hostile to outsiders, especially raiders who are as evil as they come. So why would the Divine Matron be so "kind" as to offer the panacea?
c90bef12-44c0-435e-95b7-ddbaca24c26e/Opt.cn: 五仙教素来仇视外族，况乎贼匪之流无恶不作，圣姑何以“好心”赐药……
c90bef12-44c0-435e-95b7-ddbaca24c26e/Opt.ru: Секта пяти Бессмертных всегда была враждебна к чужакам, особенно к рейдерам, которые настолько злы, насколько это возможно. Так почему же Божественная матрона была так "добра", что предложила панацею?

a65ca528-6914-4a5c-82de-d9c29eb045ce/Eve.en: "Thank you, Divine Matron.<NL>We'll never forget your kindness,"<NL><NL><Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/> says, bowing deeply.<NL>But when lowering <Character key=CombatCharId str=GenderPossessive/> head, <Character key=CombatCharId str=GenderPossessive/> eyes dart around, a sly expression forming on <Character key=CombatCharId str=GenderPossessive/> face.<NL>Clearly, there is something else in <Character key=CombatCharId str=GenderPossessive/> mind...
a65ca528-6914-4a5c-82de-d9c29eb045ce/Eve.cn: “多谢圣姑赐药，<NL>圣姑大恩大德，我寨众人一定铭记于心……”<NL><NL><Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>拱手拜谢，<NL>垂首之时，眼睛滴溜乱转，面上神色狡狯，<NL>显然心中所想绝非好事……

54400125-8f0e-4815-a902-2acc4d3869df/Eve.en: The woman turns around, sees <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>'s reaction,<NL>and just smiles like she's already expected it. She says softly,<NL><NL>"Once the Divine Matron knows, she'll definitely feel relieved,<NL>and she can finally head to the ancestors' shrine with others without worry..."
54400125-8f0e-4815-a902-2acc4d3869df/Eve.cn: 那苗妇转身见得<Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>此般模样，<NL>竟是莞尔一笑，对其反应似是早有预料一般，又缓缓说道：<NL><NL>“圣姑知晓之后，心中定然欣慰，<NL>也可放心与五仙众人前往参祭祖先了……”

54400125-8f0e-4815-a902-2acc4d3869df/Opt.en: Isn't the Divine Matron basically inviting trouble into her own home? What's the real reason behind this?
54400125-8f0e-4815-a902-2acc4d3869df/Opt.cn: 圣姑此番岂非引狼入室？此举究竟有何深意……
54400125-8f0e-4815-a902-2acc4d3869df/Opt.ru: Разве Божественная матрона, по сути, не приглашает неприятности в свой собственный дом? В чем истинная причина этого?

9564b2cb-99d0-4d31-bd94-d19216bc45db/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels more confused. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> can't figure out what the Divine Matron is really planning.<NL>She's always cared about Miaojiang—why would she bring outsiders in? Could someone be faking her orders?<NL>But if so, who among the Five Immortals would dare pull something like this?
9564b2cb-99d0-4d31-bd94-d19216bc45db/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中惊疑不定，实难参透圣姑此举深意，<NL>圣姑心系苗疆，何以引狼入室，若或有人假托圣姑之言？<NL>只是五仙当中，又有何人如此大胆妄为……

8a762bf2-39a1-4628-ac86-b95e4b45d7c1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is filled with doubts, unable to make sense of it no matter how much <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> thinks about it.<NL>Suddenly, a sharp pain shoots through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> chest, like a thousand insects crawling under <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> skin.<NL>It is unbearable, and before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> knows it, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> lets go and staggers back, feeling <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> feet firm on the ground. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> realizes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> has snapped out of the space,<NL>and when <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> glances to the side, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees Ran Xindu clutching her chest, her eyes burning with hatred...
8a762bf2-39a1-4628-ac86-b95e4b45d7c1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心中重重疑虑，百思莫解，<NL>忽觉心头阵痛难当，好似千虫噬万蚁咬，<NL>一时禁受不住，松开手来，倒退数步，自感脚踩实地，已然出离他人意海，<NL>侧首只见苒心毒紧捂胸口，满目恨色……

8a762bf2-39a1-4628-ac86-b95e4b45d7c1/Opt.en: (Did Ran Xindu see the same vision too?)
8a762bf2-39a1-4628-ac86-b95e4b45d7c1/Opt.ru: (Неужели Ран Синду тоже видел то же самое видение?)

c76b14d7-534f-4f6b-b826-4063d7eaf70b/Eve.en: "That sly outsider must've pulled some dirty trick, messing with my Gu poison and making up lies!<NL>The Holy Maiden cares about us. Why would she give the unique pills to those scoundrels?"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has returned to normal and walked up to Ran Xindu.<NL>Hearing her words, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> can't help but speak up...
c76b14d7-534f-4f6b-b826-4063d7eaf70b/Eve.cn: “狡猾呢外族人使什么诡计，破我呢蛊，乱编胡话，<NL>阿嬷怜爱苗人，怎会将秘药给狗贼……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>已复如常，当即行至苒心毒身前，<NL>听闻此言，不禁开口道……

c76b14d7-534f-4f6b-b826-4063d7eaf70b/Opt.en: <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/> doesn't know anything about Gu. No way <Character key=CombatCharId str=GenderSubject/> can break your Gu poison...
c76b14d7-534f-4f6b-b826-4063d7eaf70b/Opt.cn: <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/>不通蛊术，恐怕无法破你毒蛊……
c76b14d7-534f-4f6b-b826-4063d7eaf70b/Opt.ru: <Character key=CombatCharId str=Name/> ничего не знает о Гу. Ни за что <Character key=CombatCharId str=GenderSubject/> может разрушить Яд твоего Гу...

1013c089-ddb1-4467-98ac-a9ad285a14e6/Eve.en: "That's just because my Gu arts aren't strong enough and my Gu get lazy.<NL>Are you seriously trying to tell me it was the Holy Maiden who gave them the pills,<NL>just to lure those bastards into the stockade and slaughter our people?"<NL><NL>Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can finish,<NL>Ran Xindu's face turns cold. She snaps her head toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, her eyes full of hate, grief, and a mess of other emotions.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can feel it—one more wrong word, and Ran Xindu might suffer Pure Deviation and get Poison Burst.<NL>The thought sends a chill through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart, and a sudden idea flashes in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind.<NL>But before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can catch it, the idea slips away...
1013c089-ddb1-4467-98ac-a9ad285a14e6/Eve.cn: “那也是我蛊术不精，蛊儿偷懒，<NL>难道你要同我说就是阿嬷叫人给呢药，引那狗贼入寨，<NL>杀我苗人么？”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>话音未落，<NL>苒心毒神色一冷，转看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，目中怨恨、哀戚种种心绪交织，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只恐再多言一句，苒心毒立时便要走火入魔，心毒发作，<NL>思及此处，不禁心头一颤，蓦地生出一念，<NL>只是不待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>抓住，便又转瞬消泯……

fd97b47d-a9ba-497a-a2dc-4be5863ce0e3/Eve.en: Suddenly, ancient music drifts through the air, getting closer.<NL>The thick, toxic miasma rolls in, and swarms of insects, snakes, rats, and ants come crawling out from every direction.<NL>Four disciples from the Five Immortals Sect carry a sedan chair at the front, with more followers trailing behind.<NL>The chair is covered in sheer silk, and though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can see a figure sitting inside,<NL>it's too blurry to make out who it is...
fd97b47d-a9ba-497a-a2dc-4be5863ce0e3/Eve.cn: 突然间阵阵古音，由远及近，<NL>道间毒烟雾瘴弥漫，虫蛇鼠蚁齐出，<NL>四名五仙教弟子肩扛轿辇在前，其余五仙教人跟随在后，<NL>那轿辇四周围以轻纱，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只见其间人影朦胧，<NL>却难以辨别究竟乃是何人……

fd97b47d-a9ba-497a-a2dc-4be5863ce0e3/Opt.en: What a scene! Could it be the Divine Matron...
fd97b47d-a9ba-497a-a2dc-4be5863ce0e3/Opt.cn: 好大的阵仗，莫非乃是圣姑亲临……
fd97b47d-a9ba-497a-a2dc-4be5863ce0e3/Opt.ru: Что за сцена! Может быть, это Божественная матрона?..

a8d7cf82-e501-4795-bbac-19f895dd0533/Eve.en: "My Kid, you're the supreme Gu Immortal of this world. How can you ever look down on yourself?<NL>It's true, I am the one who gave the order. I just never expected those outsiders to be so cruel and savage, using the unique poisons to slaughter our people.<NL>But now you see it clearly, don't you? Outsiders are vicious by nature, and they can never be trusted.<NL>If the Quintessence Heartbane isn't completed and the unique poisons spread beyond our sect, the Miao people will have a hard time surviving..."<NL><NL>In the blink of an eye, the whole group stops right in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Ran Xindu.<NL>From the sedan, a soft sigh echoes out, followed by a gentle voice.<NL>Every word is tender and full of care, especially when talking something about Ran Xindu—a voice filled with deep affection.<NL>So it has to be the Divine Matron, no doubt about it.
a8d7cf82-e501-4795-bbac-19f895dd0533/Eve.cn: “我儿乃天下至尊的蛊仙，怎可妄自菲薄？<NL>此事确是我所授意，只是未曾想到，外族人歹毒蛮横，却利用秘药诛杀我苗人，<NL>我儿你今日可看清了，外族人凶残成性，难以相与，<NL>若然心毒不成，秘药流传于外，苗人今后恐难以自处……”<NL><NL>眨眼之间，一众五仙教人便已行至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与苒心毒身前，<NL>辇中之人一声轻叹，而后缓缓道来，细语和声，<NL>言及“我儿”之时，更是语重心长，爱怜百般，<NL>却不是圣姑又是何人？

a8d7cf82-e501-4795-bbac-19f895dd0533/Opt.en: (These bandits have no loyalty to anyone. Maybe the Divine Matron let them in on purpose...)
a8d7cf82-e501-4795-bbac-19f895dd0533/Opt.cn: （贼匪贪残无厌，怎分族类，圣姑引狼入室，竟好似有意为之……）
a8d7cf82-e501-4795-bbac-19f895dd0533/Opt.ru: (Эти бандиты никому не преданы. Может быть, Божественная матрона впустила их нарочно...)

a96983fb-bc5c-4191-91f3-1d2762ba01e6/Eve.en: "Granny, why would you do this to our people..."<NL><NL>Ran Xindu stands frozen for a moment, then looks up at the Divine Matron.<NL>Her face still shows disbelief, and her eyes are somehow filled with tears...
a96983fb-bc5c-4191-91f3-1d2762ba01e6/Eve.cn: “阿嬷干什么要这么害族人……”<NL><NL>苒心毒怔愣片刻，抬首看向圣姑，<NL>面上仍是不可置信，眼中不知何时盛满清泪……
a96983fb-bc5c-4191-91f3-1d2762ba01e6/Eve.ru: "Бабушка, зачем ты так поступила с нашими людьми..."<NL><NL>Ран Синду на мгновение застывает, затем поднимает глаза на Божественную матрону.<NL>На ее лице все еще отражается недоверие, а глаза почему-то наполняются слезами...

ca58a2cd-ffbe-4567-94ef-3b8467f5fb3e/Eve.en: Just as Ran Xindu finishes speaking,<NL><Character key=SectLeader str=Identity/> from the Five Immortals Sect gracefully steps out from beneath the sedan.<NL>"The Divine Matron did all this for the future of Miaojiang. As the Divine Maiden, sworn to protect Miaojiang, you should be on her side.<NL>Once you complete the Quintessence Heartbane and pass it down to us,<NL>no matter how many armies the outsiders have, they'll be nothing to us!"<NL><NL>Hearing this, a light suddenly clicks in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind.<NL>That half-formed idea <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> lost earlier now comes rushing back...
ca58a2cd-ffbe-4567-94ef-3b8467f5fb3e/Eve.cn: 苒心毒话音甫落，<NL>轿辇之下五仙教<Character key=SectLeader str=Identity/>翩然走出：<NL>“圣姑此番实为苗疆大计，圣女既身为蛊仙，立誓守护苗疆，<NL>应当理解圣姑一番苦心，今日只待圣女炼成五圣心毒，传予五仙教人，<NL>那些外族人纵有千军万马，又算得什么了？”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听闻此言，福至心灵，<NL>适才未即抓住之念，倏又冒出……

ca58a2cd-ffbe-4567-94ef-3b8467f5fb3e/Opt.en: (The Quintessence Heartbane feeds on sorrow, rage, fear, and grief... Could it be that everything the Divine Matron did was to break through its bottleneck?)
ca58a2cd-ffbe-4567-94ef-3b8467f5fb3e/Opt.cn: （五圣心毒以哀怨怒惧为食，圣姑此举莫非关乎五圣心毒玄关？）
ca58a2cd-ffbe-4567-94ef-3b8467f5fb3e/Opt.ru: (Квинтэссенция Heartbane питается печалью, яростью, страхом и огорчением... Могло ли быть так, что все, что делала Божественная Матрона, было сделано для того, чтобы прорваться через это узкое место?)

2cb1d070-3891-487c-9d7e-9069ad39e17e/Eve.en: But how to break through the bottleneck?<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> thinks, realizing that it is both painful and difficult to master. The way to break through might be hidden here.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> is deep in thought, Ran Xindu suddenly speaks, her voice full of sorrow, and anyone who hears it can't help but feel heartache...<NL><NL>"To sever all bonds, to hold onto hatred and resentment... So, it was all part of Granny's plan to force me to break through this bottleneck.<NL>You let the outsiders invade our land and slaughter our people on purpose?"
2cb1d070-3891-487c-9d7e-9069ad39e17e/Eve.cn: 只是心毒玄关，何以突破？<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心想此术离乐得苦，突破玄关之法恐怕亦系此间，<NL>正自思索之时，苒心毒已然开口，语气哀痛难抑，闻者泪流神伤……<NL><NL>“绝义断情，万恨千仇……原来阿嬷是为了叫我突破玄关，<NL>故意设计，让狗贼入寨，屠杀族人？”

05e04057-7ed7-4ce2-865c-45caec651292/Eve.en: "To break through the bottleneck,<NL>your heart must be filled with hatred and anger—there can be no love, no loyalty.<NL>But, my kid, you have already forgotten the blood debt of our people, and can't let go of the kindness I've shown you.<NL>So, I had no choice but to make you see the true nature of these outsiders. If this makes you hate me, then so be it, at least we will get what we sought..."<NL><NL>Suddenly, hundreds of spiritual butterflies flutter out from the sedan, lifting the veil.<NL>Inside, the Divine Matron sits, her face veiled, with a poised posture, her brows delicately arched—just like she always is.<NL>Her voice is gentle, but underneath, there's a hidden force, as though she's pressuring someone.<NL>With every word <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> heard, it feels like sinking into a cold pit.<NL>Little by little, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> limbs grow cold, and even <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart feels like it's freezing over...
05e04057-7ed7-4ce2-865c-45caec651292/Eve.cn: “欲要突破心毒玄关，<NL>心中只可有仇有恨，万不能有情有义，<NL>可我儿已然忘记苗人的血海深仇，又放不下我这老妇微末的养育恩德，<NL>我只好叫你看清这些外族人本性，你若因此仇恨于我，也算求仁得仁……”<NL><NL>轿内忽而涌出百只灵蝶，扬起轻纱，<NL>但见其间圣姑面戴薄纱，正襟危坐，蛾眉宛转，一如往昔，<NL>闻她音声轻柔，言辞之间，却隐含逼迫之意，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听得一字，便如堕冰窖一分，<NL>渐而四肢寒凉，心亦僵冷……

05e04057-7ed7-4ce2-865c-45caec651292/Opt.en: To achieve your goal, you will stop at nothing—even sacrificing your own people, even forcing your beloved one...
05e04057-7ed7-4ce2-865c-45caec651292/Opt.cn: 圣姑为达目的，果真不择手段，便连族人亦可屠杀，女儿亦可逼迫……
05e04057-7ed7-4ce2-865c-45caec651292/Opt.ru: Чтобы достичь своей цели, вы ни перед чем не остановитесь — даже пожертвуете собственным народом, даже заставите своего любимого человека...

0f6342fb-58d0-4697-b578-31b979c527d9/Eve.en: When these followers hear that, they all turn pale and look angry.<NL>Several disicples even step foward, ready to challenge <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, but the Divine Matron raises her hand to stop them.<NL>She stays calm, leans forward, and looks at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>. After a moment, she sighs and says helplessly,<NL><NL>"Heartbind Gu...<NL>My kid, what have you done? When did you channel the Heartbind Gu into the Successor of Taiwu?<NL>With this bond between you, it's no wonder you couldn't complete the Quintessence Heartbane..."
0f6342fb-58d0-4697-b578-31b979c527d9/Eve.cn: 五仙教众人闻言，俱是面色一白，面露恼恨，<NL>其中数名五仙弟子更跨步向前，欲与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>出手一斗，却被圣姑抬手阻止，<NL>圣姑神情如常，倾身向前，凝眸看向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，片刻过后，无奈说道：<NL><NL>“同心蛊……<NL>我儿好了不得，何时竟给太吾传人下了同心蛊？<NL>有此牵绊，无怪非不肯炼成五圣心毒了……”

6d5931f9-9553-467e-88aa-758c31c9cf28/Eve.en: "Side by side, hearts entwined. Love and grace forever aligned.<NL>It's a secret Gu from Miaojiang, used between lovers.<NL>When it takes hold, their hearts and minds are in sync, without needing words.<NL>You two haven't fully developed the Gu yet, but you've nurtured it to this point. Sometimes you can even feel each other's thoughts. That shows your bond is special..."
6d5931f9-9553-467e-88aa-758c31c9cf28/Eve.cn: “比翼同心，恩爱沾黏，<NL>此蛊乃我苗疆种于情人间的秘蛊，<NL>若然成蛊，二人自此心合意同，不言而喻，<NL>你二人蛊虽未成，但能养至此般，偶然心意相通，也证明你二人情谊非比寻常了……”

6d5931f9-9553-467e-88aa-758c31c9cf28/Opt.en: (So, the Gu Ran Xindu channeled is called "Heartbind"...)
6d5931f9-9553-467e-88aa-758c31c9cf28/Opt.cn: （原来苒心毒所下之蛊，名为同心……）
6d5931f9-9553-467e-88aa-758c31c9cf28/Opt.ru: (Итак, ченнелинг Гу Ран Синду называется "Привязка к сердцу"...)

d052711d-8a4b-4ab9-85cf-9d832eeb7e6f/Eve.en: "I did it just for fun.<NL>I hate <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, resent <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, can't stand <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>,<NL>There's no bond at all."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is still lost in thought<NL>when <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> suddenly hears Ran Xindu argue back.<NL>Seeing the anxious look on her face, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> realizes that even though her words sound harsh, she's actually trying to protect <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>.<NL>Moved by this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> makes up <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind, steps forward, and gently grabs Ran Xindu's wrist...
d052711d-8a4b-4ab9-85cf-9d832eeb7e6f/Eve.cn: “我下着玩呢，<NL>心中只厌<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Gender/>、恨<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Gender/>、讨厌<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Gender/>，<NL>哪里又有什么情谊？”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正自出神，<NL>忽听得苒心毒出言反驳，又见她面露急色，<NL>岂不知她口中虽是厌恨之语，其实皆是回护之意，不免为之动容，<NL>心中已自有一番决意，当即上前轻轻握住苒心毒手腕……

d052711d-8a4b-4ab9-85cf-9d832eeb7e6f/Opt.en: No need for more words. The situation is too urgent. Even if you tell me to leave, I'm not going anywhere...
d052711d-8a4b-4ab9-85cf-9d832eeb7e6f/Opt.cn: 不必多言，今日情势危急，纵是你赶我走，我也是不走的……
d052711d-8a4b-4ab9-85cf-9d832eeb7e6f/Opt.ru: Больше не нужно слов. Ситуация слишком срочная. Даже если ты скажешь мне уйти, я никуда не уйду...

8c595975-73ae-4384-aa4a-bcfa99f8bc98/Eve.en: Ran Xindu's eyes widen in shock. She freezes for a moment, then tears fall.<NL><NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>... can't you tell?<NL>Granny won't let you live. She wants to force me to complete the Quintessence Heartbane. Why would you stay?<NL>There's no one else as foolish as you in the world..."
8c595975-73ae-4384-aa4a-bcfa99f8bc98/Eve.cn: 苒心毒目露惊异之色，怔愣片刻，竟是落下泪来：<NL><NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>难道听不出来，<NL>阿嬷为逼我炼成五圣心毒，绝饶不了你嘛，你为什么要留下了，<NL>像你这样傻呢人，天底下没有第二个……”

8c595975-73ae-4384-aa4a-bcfa99f8bc98/Opt.en: I'm here, so you've got one on your side...
8c595975-73ae-4384-aa4a-bcfa99f8bc98/Opt.cn: 有我在此，你便多一份助力……
8c595975-73ae-4384-aa4a-bcfa99f8bc98/Opt.ru: Я здесь, так что один на твоей стороне...

f8b395ca-99ff-44bd-8d30-0a28a5c04ec2/Eve.en: "Well, well...<NL>You're loyal and true. You're better than most outsiders. She wasn't wrong about you.<NL>But if she wants to complete the Quintessence Heartbane, the first step is to kill you..."<NL><NL>The Divine Matron shakes her head slightly, with a sad look in her eyes.<NL>She then turns to Ran Xindu and speaks slowly...
f8b395ca-99ff-44bd-8d30-0a28a5c04ec2/Eve.cn: “好啊……<NL>你意重情深，胜过许多外族人，我儿倒是没有看错了你，<NL>只可惜今日我儿欲成五圣心毒，首要需得除去了你……”<NL><NL>圣姑微微摇头，目露怜惜之色，<NL>转而看向苒心毒，缓缓又道……

f8c9f0a0-cb09-4d73-bf89-f5d09c99d9d5/Eve.en: "Don't go soft, my kid.<NL>Outsiders have brought endless pain to our Miao people. How can you forgive them?<NL>If you want to take revenge, start by killing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and cutting all ties. Then kill me.<NL>After that, use the blood of outsiders to complete the Quintessence Heartbane and pass it down to our people..."
f8c9f0a0-cb09-4d73-bf89-f5d09c99d9d5/Eve.cn: “我儿莫要心软了，<NL>外族人与我苗人血海深仇，你若不报，于心何忍？<NL>你若要报，今日且先诛<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>绝情，再杀我老妇断义，<NL>后以外族人鲜血为祭，炼成五圣心毒，传予五仙族人……”

6c0c8eed-4a64-4c09-94b6-522a89a409e2/Eve.en: Sadness burns in Ran Xindu's heart like fire.<NL>But with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> standing by her side, she holds on to her mind and doesn't let the poison burst.<NL>She steps forward and shields <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> behind her.<NL><NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> helped me, and you raised me. How could I kill either of you?<NL>The Quintessence Heartbane goes against who we are. I will never pass it on to the Miao people.<NL>You might have forgotten the prophecy in the poem, but I haven't. You don't need to force me anymore..."<NL>Hearing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a deep stir in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> remembers the poem <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> found in Rite of the Star, and recites...
6c0c8eed-4a64-4c09-94b6-522a89a409e2/Eve.cn: 苒心毒心中悲伤，如焚如抽，<NL>只因<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>始终相伴在侧，仍能保持神智，不至心毒发作，<NL>当即阔步上前，将<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>护于身后：<NL><NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>帮助我，阿嬷养育我，我怎么能杀？<NL>五圣心毒违背苗人本性，我也绝不传给五仙族人，<NL>阿嬷忘记了诗上呢预言，可是我绝对不会忘记，阿嬷不用再逼我……”<NL>苒心毒此言一出，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心有所感，<NL>思及祭星神典所得诗稿，不禁诵念出声……

6c0c8eed-4a64-4c09-94b6-522a89a409e2/Opt.en: A sea of hatred drowns the peaks, a blaze of wrath lays forests weak. From then, the Miao people know naught but pain, their bitter cries lost in endless rain...
6c0c8eed-4a64-4c09-94b6-522a89a409e2/Opt.cn: 仇海滔天万山崩，恨火烧山千树死，从此苗人不聊生，世代皆苦怎堪言……
6c0c8eed-4a64-4c09-94b6-522a89a409e2/Opt.ru: Море ненависти топит вершины, пламя гнева ослабляет леса. С тех пор народ Мяо не знает ничего, кроме боли, их горькие крики теряются в бесконечном дожде...

f5987101-0d8a-4c5f-ab51-95aa8172bd38/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> always knows the Quintessence Heartbane is a twisted, dangerous art.<NL>But <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> does not know its true power and what completing it will truly do to the Miao people.<NL>So <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> has just been following Ran Xindu's wishes all along...<NL><NL>But now, at this moment, it's like their hearts are one. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> understands her without words.<NL>Ran Xindu believes people should be judged by good and evil, not by whether they're ousiders or not. She refuses to kill the innocent.<NL>And because the art goes against the Miao people's true nature, and the old poem warns against it, she won't break its bottleneck<NL>and pass it down to the Five Immortals Sect members...
f5987101-0d8a-4c5f-ab51-95aa8172bd38/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只知五圣心毒修炼法门诡谲无比，<NL>但其威力如何，习成之后又于苗疆有何后果，均是不知所以，<NL>至此种种行事，皆是顺从苒心毒心意而为……<NL><NL>然此时此刻，竟好似与苒心毒神会心契，但知苒心毒心中所想，<NL>一因世无族类之别，唯有好坏之分，是以不愿滥杀无辜，<NL>二因此术违逆苗人本性，又有诗稿印证，故而不意突破心毒玄关，<NL>将之传予五仙教人……

f5987101-0d8a-4c5f-ab51-95aa8172bd38/Opt.en: Killing love, cutting off all ties, turning right and wrong upside down... It will lead to self-destruction. This art should never be practiced...
f5987101-0d8a-4c5f-ab51-95aa8172bd38/Opt.cn: 断情绝义，是非不分，岂不正如飞蛾赴烛，自取灭亡，此术确实不当修炼……
f5987101-0d8a-4c5f-ab51-95aa8172bd38/Opt.ru: Убивая любовь, обрывая все связи, переворачивая правильное и неправильное с ног на голову... Это приведет к саморазрушению. Этим искусством никогда не следует заниматься...

5e4f75ea-9baa-4859-9cbb-c289bf0b7c9c/Eve.en: Ran Xindu feels troubled, lost in thought. After hearing what <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> said,<NL>it feels like her heart is connected with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s. There's no one else in the world who understands her this way.<NL>In this moment of danger, she can't help but turn back and smile at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
5e4f75ea-9baa-4859-9cbb-c289bf0b7c9c/Eve.cn: 苒心毒心中忧愁，万虑千思，被<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一语道出，<NL>只觉与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心心相印，世间再也没有第二人，<NL>危难当前，也不禁回首向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>报以一笑……

ab416ad1-48c9-4bf1-97cf-d8a7033f47c8/Eve.en: The Five Immortals Sect disciples, having heard the prophecy in the poem, are already uneasy.<NL>Now that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> explains the core of the Quintessence Heartbane,<NL>they can't help but feel confused and worried, even though they know the power of the art.<NL>But the Divine Matron is the leader of the Miao people, and no one dares to question her authority...
ab416ad1-48c9-4bf1-97cf-d8a7033f47c8/Eve.cn: 五仙众弟子听闻诗稿预言，本已惴惴不安，<NL>而今<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>又一言道明五圣心毒要义，<NL>众人纵然知晓此术神威无俦，也不禁面露惶惑、纠结之色，<NL>只是圣姑身为苗人之首，威严使然，五仙众人一时却也无胆出言质疑……

ab416ad1-48c9-4bf1-97cf-d8a7033f47c8/Opt.en: As the Divine Matron, you're wise and sharp. Does it really take an outsider like me to tell you whether the Quintessence Heartbane should be passed down?
ab416ad1-48c9-4bf1-97cf-d8a7033f47c8/Opt.cn: 圣姑聪明睿智，五圣心毒当不当传，难道还不及我一个外族人看得透么？
ab416ad1-48c9-4bf1-97cf-d8a7033f47c8/Opt.ru: Как Божественная матрона, ты мудра и проницательна. Действительно ли нужно быть таким посторонним, как я, чтобы сказать вам, следует ли передавать квинтэссенцию Heartbane по наследству?

1fc2d2a4-4670-4841-9d8a-9622325bc99e/Eve.en: "Spreading lies to confuse the crowd, that's punishable!<NL>Fine. Since you won't take action,<NL>let me do it for you. Let's see what the Successor of Taiwu has got..."<NL><NL>Before her words even end, the surrounding spiritual butterflies suddenly form into a whip<NL>and lash out at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> barely has time to react before the whip tip is right in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>.
1fc2d2a4-4670-4841-9d8a-9622325bc99e/Eve.cn: “讹言惑众，其心可诛，<NL>也罢，我儿既然不忍动手，<NL>今日就让老妇来领教领教太吾传人的本事吧……”<NL><NL>圣姑音声未落，其四周灵蝶忽而凝聚成鞭，<NL>赫然向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>袭来，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>未及反应，鞭梢已然掠至眼前！

b81781b1-9964-4537-b6e5-680608f6a856/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gasps in surprise, about to dodge, but suddenly feels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hand is empty.<NL>In a moment of panic, Ran Xindu breaks free from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s grip, leaping in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> to shield <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>.<NL>She mutters a Miaojiang dialect incantation and blocks the long whip. In an instant,<NL>the whip transforms into fluttering spiritual butterflies, scattering in all directions...
b81781b1-9964-4537-b6e5-680608f6a856/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一声惊呼，正欲飞身闪避，忽觉手上一空，<NL>却是苒心毒情急之下，挣脱<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>五指，跃至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前相护，<NL>但见她口念苗疆密语，出手格挡长鞭，只一霎时，<NL>长鞭又忽化作翩翩灵蝶，四散而去……

b81781b1-9964-4537-b6e5-680608f6a856/Opt.en: (The whip, made from spiritual butterflies, is both real and illusionary, very tricky. Without Ran Xindu's intervention, it would have been hard to stop...)
b81781b1-9964-4537-b6e5-680608f6a856/Opt.cn: （此鞭灵蝶所化，虚虚实实，极为诡异，若非苒心毒出手，倒难化解……）
b81781b1-9964-4537-b6e5-680608f6a856/Opt.ru: (Кнут, сделанный из духовных бабочек, одновременно реален и иллюзорен, очень хитер. Без вмешательства Ран Синду это было бы трудно остановить...)

The sound of silver bells rings in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> ears, each chime urging <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> on.<NL>It's the sign that the Quintessence Heartbane is about to get into Pure Deviation!
ed076def-d3dc-43c1-9369-83e99588493e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身受重伤，躺倒于一片血泊当中，<NL>神智模糊间，只觉苒心毒行至身侧，轻轻握住自己双手……<NL>不觉心中哀痛，汹涌难抑，耳畔银铃作响，声声催人，<NL>正是五圣心毒走火入魔之兆！

45fd1c5c-d98e-4688-89d4-3f322ca0f317/Eve.en: Life and death hang by a thread.<NL>In the final clash, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> knocks the Divine Matron to the ground. But just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> moves to finish it, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> freezes.<NL>A purple shadow flashes in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> blocking <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> way. Who else but Ran Xindu would do something like this?
45fd1c5c-d98e-4688-89d4-3f322ca0f317/Eve.cn: 生死之战，间不容发，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将圣姑击倒在地，心念一动，却忽而顿在原处，<NL>紧接着一道紫影便从身侧闪出，挡于圣姑身前，不是苒心毒又是何人？

45fd1c5c-d98e-4688-89d4-3f322ca0f317/Opt.en: Are you asking me to go easy on her and spare her life?
45fd1c5c-d98e-4688-89d4-3f322ca0f317/Opt.cn: 你要叫我手下留情，饶她一命么？
45fd1c5c-d98e-4688-89d4-3f322ca0f317/Opt.ru: Ты просишь меня быть с ней помягче и сохранить ей жизнь?

8b1c9708-1886-40bb-9cb3-0eeb65538442/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> tries to stop it,<NL>but feels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyelids heavy and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body weak.<NL>In the end, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> just falls into a deep sleep...
8b1c9708-1886-40bb-9cb3-0eeb65538442/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>欲要制止，<NL>可只觉眼皮沉沉，通体无力，<NL>终是就此昏睡了过去……
8b1c9708-1886-40bb-9cb3-0eeb65538442/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> пытается остановить это,<NL>но чувствует <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> веки отяжелели и <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> тело слабое.<NL>В конце концов, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> просто погружается в глубокий сон...

e36622f9-aa41-4831-9239-94d203315748/Eve.en: Not sure how much time has passed...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly feels a gentle breeze, refreshing and calming.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> can't help but feel relaxed and at peace, slowly waking up. As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> looks around,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees the dead come back to life, the wounded healed, withered branches sprout, and dying grass grow again.<NL>Everything is reborn...
e36622f9-aa41-4831-9239-94d203315748/Eve.cn: 不知过了许久……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽感和气悠扬，清风吹拂，<NL>不由得通体舒畅，心旷神怡，竟是悠悠转醒，转而四顾，<NL>但见四周死者转生，伤者平复，枯枝萌芽，衰草展叶，<NL>万物生发……

e36622f9-aa41-4831-9239-94d203315748/Opt.en: (Wasn't I already killed by the Divine Matron? How am I still alive... and where's Ran Xindu...?)
e36622f9-aa41-4831-9239-94d203315748/Opt.cn: （我本已命丧圣姑之手，何以死而复生，苒心毒又在何处……）
e36622f9-aa41-4831-9239-94d203315748/Opt.ru: (Разве я уже не был убит Божественной Матроной? Как я до сих пор жив... и где Ран Синду...?)

5127c4c8-7670-42b2-94f9-2cb5c044acf4/Eve.en: All sorts of things flood <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind, confusing and unsolvable.<NL>Just then, a familiar voice echoes in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s ears.<NL>It's mixed with feelings of joy, anger, sorrow, and worry, making it hard to understand...<NL><NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, I've finally completed the Quintessence Heartbane... What will happen to Miaojiang now?<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, I can't bear to see my people die, nor can I let you and granny get stuck in sleep forever.<NL>After thinking it over, I've come up with a way. I'll trade my life for yours.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, too bad. If there's a next life, I don't want to be a Gu Immortal anymore..."<NL>As the last words fade, the voice disappears in the wind...
5127c4c8-7670-42b2-94f9-2cb5c044acf4/Eve.cn: 诸般问题，涌上心头，纷乱无解，<NL>正在此时，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>耳边忽然响起一道熟悉的声音，<NL>似喜似怒，似哀似愁，难明其意……<NL><NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>，五圣心毒我还是炼成了，以后苗疆可怎么办呢……<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>，我不忍见族人身死，也不忍让你和阿嬷就这样长眠，<NL>想来想去，我终于想到一个法子，用我呢命来换你们呢命，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>，可惜啦，如果有下辈子，我不要再做蛊仙了……”<NL>说至最后，音声逐渐消散于风中……

95b41f21-3d08-4ec9-aa37-864f62e688b9/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks around,<NL>but doesn't see Ran Xindu. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> feels an emptiness in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart.<NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> is lost in thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees the Divine Matron holding a book, sitting solemnly in her sedan.<NL>"Our sect's grudges will never fade, no matter how many years pass. Now that the Quintessence Heartbane is complete,<NL>our people swear to avenge and honor the countless lost souls..."<NL><NL>From afar, maple leaves fall in a flurry, and an ancient song echoes endlessly.<NL>The Miao people, however, don't seem to notice.<NL>They only bow their heads and kneel before the Divine Matron...
95b41f21-3d08-4ec9-aa37-864f62e688b9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>举目四望，<NL>果真不见苒心毒身影，顿觉心中空空，<NL>正自怅然之际，忽见圣姑正手捧一书，端坐轿辇之中：<NL>“我族仇怨，万年千载，永不沉埋，而今心毒终成，<NL>我教中人，誓要雪恨报仇，以慰万万亡魂……”<NL><NL>远处枫叶飘落，纷纷扬扬，又传来古歌声声，悠扬不绝，<NL>一众苗人却是视而不见，听而不闻，<NL>只铺胸纳地，望圣姑而叩头……

74251149-d75e-4a2d-a205-beafc4218182/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s mind is in turmoil,<NL>and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> stops caring about anything around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> turns and walks away...
74251149-d75e-4a2d-a205-beafc4218182/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>思绪繁杂，<NL>于周遭事物实无半点关切之意，便即转身离去……
74251149-d75e-4a2d-a205-beafc4218182/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>его разум в смятении,<NL>и <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> перестает заботиться обо всем вокруг <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> поворачивается и уходит...

74251149-d75e-4a2d-a205-beafc4218182/Opt.en: (The past is now just a dream. From now on, the world will never have Ran Xindu...)
74251149-d75e-4a2d-a205-beafc4218182/Opt.cn: （前尘往事，已成大梦，从此世间，再无苒心毒……）
74251149-d75e-4a2d-a205-beafc4218182/Opt.ru: (Прошлое теперь всего лишь сон. Отныне в мире никогда не будет Ран Синду...)

ffbcce96-46b8-42ef-8f57-4e27ded12188/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> has just fought alongside Ran Xindu,<NL>feeling their hearts connected, understanding each other without words.<NL>What <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> said was almost the same as what Ran Xindu was thinking.<NL>When she hears <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> speak, she pauses, then nods in agreement.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pauses for a moment, then turns <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> gaze toward the Divine Matron...
ffbcce96-46b8-42ef-8f57-4e27ded12188/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>适才与苒心毒携手而战，<NL>更觉心意相通，彼此所想，不言即喻，<NL>是以此话虽自<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>口中道出，但言中之意倒与苒心毒所想“小异大同”，<NL>苒心毒闻言，微作迟疑，便颔首相应，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>沉吟片刻，视线转向圣姑……

ffbcce96-46b8-42ef-8f57-4e27ded12188/Opt.en: What the Divine Maiden asks for, I will of course grant. But there's one more thing I must ask on her behalf: The Divine Matron... do you know you were wrong?
ffbcce96-46b8-42ef-8f57-4e27ded12188/Opt.cn: 圣女之所求，我自是应许，更有一言，要代圣女一问：圣姑……可知错了么？
ffbcce96-46b8-42ef-8f57-4e27ded12188/Opt.ru: То, о чем просит Божественная Дева, я, конечно, исполню. Но есть еще одна вещь, о которой я должен попросить от ее имени: Божественную Матрону... ты знаешь, что был неправ?

ce01ef9d-bb2c-4654-a7e5-924fa0e4611f/Eve.en: This question is exactly what Ran Xindu was thinking. Hearing it from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>she is stunned, but she can't help but look back at the Divine Matron, waiting for her answer...<NL><NL>"Know I was wrong? What's there to be sorry about?<NL>Since the battle between Chi You and the Yellow Emperor,<NL>our people have had to carry the old and young, give up our rich lands, and move to barren places, hiding in the mountains.<NL>But still, because we're weak and alone, we've been pushed around by outsiders again and again.<NL>Our people have been suffering like this for as long as I can remember..."
ce01ef9d-bb2c-4654-a7e5-924fa0e4611f/Eve.cn: 此问自是苒心毒心中所想，猛地听<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>道出，<NL>登时面露愕然，但亦不禁回首看向圣姑，待其回答……<NL><NL>“知错？知什么错……<NL>自蚩尤黄帝逐鹿一役之后，<NL>我族扶老携幼，牺牲膏腴，迁寄不毛穷壤，避难深山丘陵，<NL>可仍因势孤力弱，被外族人一再驱逐，<NL>欺我族人之事，更是历朝相沿……”

ced693f8-9d8d-46cf-9586-215ad9af9af0/Eve.en: "Our people haven't had a day of peace in hundreds of years. All that pain—of course my kid knows it too.<NL>I give everything I have for our people, plan every move, think through every step. If it weren't for losing to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> today,<NL>my kid would have fully completed the Quintessence Heartbane, granted it to the head of the Five Immortals Sect, and passed the art to the Congregant of Five Immortals Sect.<NL>Then our people could wipe out the outsiders, get our revenge,<NL>and bring our name back to glory!"<NL><NL>Even lying in a pool of blood, the Divine Matron's voice stays strong,<NL>every word sharp and fierce, shaking everyone to the core.<NL>Hearing her, Ran Xindu's eyes fill with sadness. She shakes her head, wanting to argue,<NL>but no words come out...
ced693f8-9d8d-46cf-9586-215ad9af9af0/Eve.cn: “我族百年未有安居之时，痛苦之状，我儿安能不知，<NL>我为族人呕心沥血，费尽心机，今日若非败在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手中，<NL>我儿心毒大成，赋予五仙教主，再由其传给五仙教众，<NL>从此五仙族人习成神术，自能一血仇恨，屠尽外族，<NL>重振我族威望！”<NL><NL>圣姑躺倒于一片血泊之中，仍是威仪不减，<NL>字字凄厉，句句铿锵，听者不免惊动心魄，震慑神魂，<NL>苒心毒闻言，却是目露愁色，摇头欲要反驳，<NL>却是哑然无声……

ced693f8-9d8d-46cf-9586-215ad9af9af0/Opt.en: (Feel Ran Xindu's sorrow and speak her thoughts out loud...)
ced693f8-9d8d-46cf-9586-215ad9af9af0/Opt.ru: (Почувствуй печаль Ран Синду и выскажи ее мысли вслух...)

c5489753-750c-445d-84f7-9a35e4440c70/Eve.en: Ran Xindu thinks to herself, and then <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> says,<NL><NL>"Granny always told me that outsiders are as cunning and evil as wolves,<NL>but this time, when I leave Miaojiang and go out into the world, what I see, what I feel—it's not like that...<NL>Outsiders are just like us. Some are good, and some are evil. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> and the Azure Ox of the Valley of Flowers are good, but the Donkey of the Kongsang Sect and bandits are evil.<NL>Does Granny want to be like those outsiders who chase our people away, not caring who's good or bad, just wiping them all out?<NL>If that's the case, what's the difference between us and them?"
c5489753-750c-445d-84f7-9a35e4440c70/Eve.cn: 苒心毒心中想到，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>口中说道：<NL><NL>“阿嬷从小告诉我，外族人心险恶的像豺狼一样，<NL>可是这一次我离开苗疆，去到外面，见到呢，感受到呢，却不是这样……<NL>外族人和我们是一样的，他们的心有好有坏，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>、百花谷青牛是好，空桑驴、贼匪是坏，<NL>难道阿嬷要像那些驱赶族人呢外族人一样，不分好坏，都把他们赶尽杀绝嘛？<NL>那这样呢我们，和那些人又有什么不同？”

c5489753-750c-445d-84f7-9a35e4440c70/Opt.en: The Divine Matron's obsession runs too deep. Blinded to good and evil alike, she seeks only to slaughter all outsiders, yet still feigns righteousness...
c5489753-750c-445d-84f7-9a35e4440c70/Opt.cn: 圣姑执念过甚，不分善恶好坏、只欲屠尽外族，却要装作大义凛然……
c5489753-750c-445d-84f7-9a35e4440c70/Opt.ru: Одержимость Божественной Матроны слишком глубока. Ослепленная как добром, так и злом, она стремится только к уничтожению всех чужаков, но все еще притворяется праведной...

96496349-d796-48ad-b8fe-5053aa9f1272/Eve.en: "You know the prophecy is real and that practicing the Quintessence Heartbane is dangerous.<NL>But you still want to force it on the Five Immortals Sect. You even try to use others to kill for you. You're not doing it for our people—you're doing it for yourself.<NL>You want to make a name for yourself, drive out all outsiders, and build your own empire.<NL>You never once truly think about what's best for our people..."
96496349-d796-48ad-b8fe-5053aa9f1272/Eve.cn: “阿嬷更明知诗稿预言来之有据，修炼五圣心毒实有危害，<NL>却仍还想加诸五仙教人，甚至不惜借刀杀人，非为族人，而为了自己，<NL>阿嬷欲成一番不世之功，要摈斥异族，要图王霸业，<NL>却不曾半分真心为族人设想……”

96496349-d796-48ad-b8fe-5053aa9f1272/Opt.en: As the Divine Matron, you only think about yourself. You use your own people and have others kill for you, but you still don't feel even a little bit sorry...
96496349-d796-48ad-b8fe-5053aa9f1272/Opt.cn: 圣姑私心妄念，设计族人、借刀杀之，却丝毫不知悔改么……
96496349-d796-48ad-b8fe-5053aa9f1272/Opt.ru: Как Божественная матрона, ты думаешь только о себе. Ты используешь своих людей и заставляешь других убивать за тебя, но ты все равно ни капельки не сожалеешь...

6f4e3c0e-917f-4f87-bb93-209663b893e0/Eve.en: "Every life is precious. How can you decide whose life gets traded for our future?<NL>Our people respect all living things and know right from wrong. We will never shut off our hearts or let hatred drive us mad to complete the Quintessence Heartbane.<NL>The outland raiders who hurt us are wrong—but you... You not only force our people to sacrifice their bodies, but also crush their souls.<NL>You are the real monster destroying our land—the evil spirits 'Jia Ga' and 'Jia Ning'!"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s voice rings out, sharp and steady, every word hitting like a hammer.<NL>Even though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> tone is much harsher than Ran Xindu's softer way of speaking,<NL>the feeling behind it is the same—true and sincere...
6f4e3c0e-917f-4f87-bb93-209663b893e0/Eve.cn: “人人性命皆是可贵，阿嬷岂可决定，以谁人性命换一族未来？<NL>苗人更崇敬万物，明辨是非，又岂会断情绝义，困于心毒，趋仇逐恨，屠尽外族，<NL>外族贼匪杀苗人身，而阿嬷不仅借刀杀族人，更诛苗人心，<NL>你才是摧毁苗疆的恶鬼‘枷嘎’、‘枷狞’！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>掷地有声，辞严厉色，<NL>虽与苒心毒待圣姑款语温言大不相同，<NL>但此中意切情真，拳拳之忱，却是一般无二，不分彼此……

6f4e3c0e-917f-4f87-bb93-209663b893e0/Opt.en: Do you still think you're innocent?
6f4e3c0e-917f-4f87-bb93-209663b893e0/Opt.cn: 圣姑难道还觉自己无错么？
6f4e3c0e-917f-4f87-bb93-209663b893e0/Opt.ru: Ты все еще думаешь, что невиновен?

5e506907-8b25-40aa-99c0-5d1cf1a65272/Eve.en: The Divine Matron, severely wounded, her mind and spirit shattered, stands frozen<NL>as she hears <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s accusation.<NL>Silence falls around her as a flood of emotions breaks within her—a surge of innocence and overwhelming shame crashing together.<NL>For a long moment, her thoughts won't settle. Her chest tightens, as if it might burst. Her eyes scan the blood-soaked ground, lingering on the bodies of the fallen.<NL>Trembling uncontrollably, a burst of blood escapes her mouth...<NL><NL>"Jia Ga, Jia Ning... I planned everything,<NL>yet somehow, step by step, I've become the monster who killed my own people and destroyed the Five Immortals..."
5e506907-8b25-40aa-99c0-5d1cf1a65272/Eve.cn: 圣姑重伤之下，心神俱损，<NL>而今听闻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>指责，顿口无言，怔愣原处，<NL>种种心绪纷至沓来，犹如堤防溃决，一时但觉无错，一时又感有罪，<NL>如是半晌，思绪积而不散，胸口几欲炸裂，视线扫向满地凄凄血痕、诸人尸体，<NL>更不禁全身发颤，一口热血，喷将而出……<NL><NL>“‘枷嘎’、‘枷狞’……我千般思量，万般筹算，<NL>何以竟一步步成了杀死族人、摧毁五仙的恶鬼……”

2f860ff8-88c4-4596-92e0-efb5fad5f1c3/Eve.en: "Life is precious, more valuable than anything, with no distinction between sects.<NL>The Miao people honor nature, not chase after hatred..."<NL><NL>The Divine Matron clutches her chest, pain and regret clear in her expression.<NL>Her gaze softens as it lands on Ran Xindu, and for a fleeting moment, affection shines through.<NL>After a long pause, she suddenly smiles faintly, reaching out to gently wipe the blood from Ran Xindu's face. Her voice trembles, sorrowful and heart-wrenching:<NL>"Only now do I realize... my kid... has grown up. You are more fit than me to lead Miaojiang...<NL>I have harmed our people. Whether I am wrong or not... there is no way to undo it now..."
